The '''Atrivis Resistance Group''' was the alliance between the [[Fest Resistance Group]] and the survivors of the [[Mantooine Liberators]] to rebel against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It pre-dated the creation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but shortly after the formation of the latter, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] convinced the Atrivis Resistance Group to merge into the Rebellion as the [[Atrivis Sector Force]].<ref name="RASB" />
